collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: At the stream, a villager hears an unkind rumor about a neighbor and is asked to pass it along.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At the stream, (name1) hears an unkind rumor about a neighbor and is asked to pass it along.

choices.label: Ask Where the Story Came From.
Speak Kindly About the Neighbor Instead.
Let the Neighbor Know a Story Is Going Around.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The person who shared it shrugs and changes the subject.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The rumor spreads anyway, but not through this villager.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Nobody can say, and the rumor loses its force in the silence.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The source turns out to be a misunderstanding about a borrowed pot.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Others add their own good memories, and the talk becomes friendlier.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The listeners seem disappointed, but the villager does not mind.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The neighbor is grateful for the warning and clears it up with one sentence.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The neighbor would rather not know the details, and the villager respects that.
